verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing claim that agents have identity, scoped permissions, data access and approved actions managed from "the same console that governs human users." That implies an access-governance capability, but it is described for AI Teammates rather than for project managers assigning view/edit roles to people on work. Missing for 10: documentation of user/guest roles, project- or task-level view vs. edit permissions, granular sharing controls for human collaborators, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
